Definition: a thorn; also (from its keenness for scratching) a gem, probably the diamond
BiblicalUsage: 1) thorn(s), adamant, flint; 1a) thorns, thorn-bushes; 1b) adamant (as sharp); 1c) a sharp stone, flint; 1c1) perhaps a diamond
